episodes.title: 223. Tia Levings: From Trad Wife to Living Her Childhood Dream
episodes.description: In today's episode, Betsy & Kate are honored to speak with New York Times best selling author of “A Well Trained Wife”, Tia Levings. After living the life of a trad wife for 13 years, Tia escaped at the age of 33 with her 4 children on the night her husband was ready to murder her. In the 19 years since her escape, she has been on a journey of healing, and coming home to herself as reflected in her newest book “I Belong to Me”. In today's episode we talk about: The 3 major chapters of Tia's life: her childhood, her 13 years as a trad wife, and her recovery, healing, and speaking truth about the cult she escaped. Why her first 10 years potentially saved her life because it gave her a template of “self” before the high control conservative church began shaping her. Her second 10 years of life when her family moved to FL and joined a mega church. How her rule-following “good girl” mentality and the church's promise of a “happy life” contributed to a life of obedience to a controlling, abusive husband. What life as an authentic trad wife really looked like vs what the trad life influencer movement suggests. How the death of her daughter 7 years before her escape was the first mental crack in the Christian Fundamentalist spell she had been under. The harrowing moment on Halloween night when she escaped with her 4 kids from a near murder-suicide in a run for their lives. How she slowly and gradually began to take herself back over the course of the last 15 years and which is at the heart of her latest book “I Belong to Me”. Bio: Tia Levings is the New York Times Bestselling author of A Well-Trained Wife, her memoir of escape from Christian Patriarchy. She writes about the realities of religious trauma, evangelical patriarchy, and the Trad wife life, decoding the fundamentalist influences in our news and culture. Her work and quotes have appeared in Teen Vogue, Salon, Newsweek, and the HuffingtonPost. She also appeared in the hit Amazon docu-series, Shiny Happy People. Based in Raleigh, North Carolina, she is mom to four incredible adults and likes to travel, hike, paint, and daydream. Her second book, I Belong to Me, came out this past year is about her 15-year quest to psychological peace after religious trauma.
